windows.intermediate_caption: Throughout the entire sequence, multiple individuals move within a large, sunlit outdoor parking lot containing numerous parked cars, vans, and trucks. At various times, different groups of pedestrians traverse the space. Two people walk from left to right near the center of the frame early in the recording. Later, two others walk from right to left in the upper left portion of the lot. Another pair moves together through the middle section— one dressed in dark clothes, the other in light-colored clothing—and they pass each other as their paths cross. Additional movements include a single pedestrian crossing from left to right in the lower-left region, another walking from left to right in the lower-left quadrant (carrying an object), and someone else proceeding from left to right in the lower-left part of the frame. In addition, persons are seen walking from right to left in the upper-left area, approaching the rear of the lot, and one continues this direction near the back among parked vehicles. Several individuals stand momentarily in fixed positions—one beside a white car located along the far edge of the lot, another near a white car in the middle of the lot, and a third adjacent to a white van in the upper-middle section. These figures remain relatively stable during brief intervals before either beginning to move again or remaining stationary until the end. No vehicular motion occurs at any point—the cars, vans, and trucks stay fully parked throughout. The environment features consistent lighting conditions indicating daytime, with clear visibility and long shadows cast across the pavement. An elevated vantage point provides wide coverage of the lot’s layout, which includes structures visible beyond its perimeter. Multiple instances describe similar elements such as a white box truck in the upper right, a marked white van in the mid-right zone, a silver sedan in the lower right, and a prominent white dumpster positioned in the lower-left foreground. Despite variations in descriptive detail per segment, there is continuity in both spatial configuration and lack of dynamic change outside of foot traffic.
